sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    d = {}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('B','Y') and 20 <= n['pixels'] <= 80:
            b = n['boundary']
            r0 = min(p[0] for p in b); r1 = max(p[0] for p in b); c0 = min(p[1] for p in b); c1 = max(p[1] for p in b)
            d.setdefault(n['color'], []).append((r0,c0,r1,c1,n['pixels']))
    return d
s0 = snap()
res = action(['SPACE'])
s1 = snap()
print('SPACE changed pieces:', s0!=s1)
res = action(['RIGHT'])
s2 = snap()
print('after RIGHT:', s2.get('B'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
